_about: India in WIPO's Global Innovation Index, editions before 2022, extracted from the official report PDFs (and the 2021 dataset xlsx). Page numbers are physical PDF pages (1-based), not printed folios. ci = 90% rank confidence interval from the JRC statistical audit (published from 2012). efficiency_rank = Innovation Efficiency Ratio rank (called 'Efficiency Index' in 2011-2012; dropped from 2019). Scores 2007-2010 are on a 1-7 scale, 2011+ on 0-100; not comparable.
back_series: No official back-calculated or framework-consistent GII time series exists for these editions. Every edition says ranks/scores are not directly comparable year to year. The only official re-computations are (a) GII 2012 Annex 2 Table 2 and GII 2013 Annex 2 Table 3, which decompose each economy's one-year rank change into performance/data, framework and sample effects; (b) the GII 2013 profile line 'Global Innovation Index 2012 (based on GII 2012 framework)'. WIPO's dataset collection on tind.wipo.int starts with GII 2021 (not checkable directly: host blocks automated clients). GII 2026 Appendix I repeats: 'scores and rankings are not directly comparable between one year and another.'
